data.summary: auto_decision (services/gates/baseline.py:146-152) counts a failing test as in the item's reach through TS.select, which honours a test's GOVERNS globs. tests/test_architecture_import_contracts.py declares GOVERNS = ("ddflow/**", ...), so while it is red on main, any item touching ddflow/ gets auto.accepted=false and complete refuses, although the failure is measured on the base and byte-identical there. Seen on fix-B-main-red-compat-startup-warning: its failure is surfaces.cli -> infra.threads, and the item only changed config/_warn.py. Only `ddflow approve` by a person settles it, so one red repo-wide guard turns every code fix on a red main into a person's approval, which D-baseline-red-auto-accept set out to avoid. Compare the guard's failure text with the base, or treat a GOVERNS-only reach differently from an import reach.
